text: Hoping to use this for my start to uni, pretty happy with the features so far. I do have a few nitpicks though. It would be nice to have more options for the subject of a class, since my classes can't be neatly sorted in the categories available now. It would also be nice to customise or color code for more clarity. The app also crashes a bit too often for me, like when editing the classes. Otherwise seems a very useful tool for organising school life
author: Pluto
developer_reply: Thanks for the detailed feedback — the custom subjects do exist though! On the crashes when editing classes: we've shipped stability fixes, so please update to the latest version. If they continue, email care@mystudylife.com with your device model and OS. Good luck at uni!
